title: The antiangiogenic effect of total saponins of Panax japonicus C.A. Meyer in rheumatoid arthritis is mediated by targeting the HIF-1alpha/VEGF/ANG-1 axis.
authors: Guo, Xiang; Zhang, Jinkai; Feng, Zhitao; Ji, Jinyu; Shen, Xiaolan; Hou, Xiaoqiang; Mei, Zhigang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究竹节参总皂苷通过HIF-1alpha/VEGF/ANG-1轴抑制类风湿关节炎血管生成，仅涉及小分子-蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine Panax japonicus C.A. Meyer has a long history in clinical treatment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Total saponins of Panax japonicus C.A. Meyer (TSPJs) were extracted from the root of Panax japonicus C.A. Meyer, and its anti-rheumatism mechanism is still unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate whether TSPJs attenuated synovial angiogenesis in RA and explore the potential mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Potential TSPJs targets involving gene function were predicted by network pharmacology related databases. Bioinformatics analysis and molecular docking technology were used to predict the mechanism of TSPJs in the treatment of RA. The predicted results were validated by cell experiments and a collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) mouse model. RESULTS: Bioinformatics analysis results showed that TSPJs may inhibit RA-related angiogenesis through the hypoxia-inducible factor-1 (HIF-1) and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) pathways. In vitro, different doses of TSPJs showed a good inhibitory effect on the tube formation of EA.hy926 cells. The results of the cellular thermal shift assay indicated that TSPJs can bind to the HIF-1alpha, VEGFA, and angiopoietin-1 (ANG-1) proteins. In vivo, the administration of TSPJs alleviated the symptoms of CIA mice, including the arthritis index, hind paw thickness, and swollen joint count. The histological results demonstrated that TSPJs inhibited inflammation, angiogenesis, bone damage, and cartilage destruction. Furthermore, TSPJs decreased the number of vessels and the expression level of CD31. The mechanistic results revealed that TSPJs decreased the expression of HIF-1alpha, VEGFA, and ANG-1 in the serum or synovial tissues of CIA mice. CONCLUSION: These results suggest that TSPJs effectively inhibit angiogenesis in RA, and the mechanism may be related to inhibiting the HIF-1alpha/VEGF/ANG-1 axis.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：传统中草药竹节参（Panax japonicus C.A. Meyer）在类风湿关节炎（RA）的临床治疗中有着悠久的历史。竹节参总皂苷（TSPJs）是从竹节参根部提取的，其抗风湿机制尚不明确。研究目的：探讨TSPJs是否减轻RA中的滑膜血管生成，并探索其潜在机制。材料与方法：通过网络药理学相关数据库预测TSPJs涉及基因功能的潜在靶点。利用生物信息学分析和分子对接技术预测TSPJs治疗RA的机制。通过细胞实验和胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）小鼠模型验证预测结果。结果：生物信息学分析结果显示，TSPJs可能通过缺氧诱导因子-1（HIF-1）和血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）通路抑制RA相关血管生成。体外实验中，不同剂量的TSPJs对EA.hy926细胞的管形成表现出良好的抑制作用。细胞热位移分析结果表明，TSPJs能与HIF-1α、VEGFA和血管生成素-1（ANG-1）蛋白结合。体内实验中，TSPJs给药减轻了CIA小鼠的症状，包括关节炎指数、后爪厚度和肿胀关节计数。组织学结果显示，TSPJs抑制了炎症、血管生成、骨损伤和软骨破坏。此外，TSPJs减少了血管数量和CD31的表达水平。机制研究结果显示，TSPJs降低了CIA小鼠血清或滑膜组织中HIF-1α、VEGFA和ANG-1的表达。结论：这些结果表明，TSPJs有效抑制RA中的血管生成，其机制可能与抑制HIF-1α/VEGF/ANG-1轴有关。
